SELECT d.fiscal_week, s.week_ending_date, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT (s.store_key, s.product_key)) dist_keys, count(DISTINCT s.etl_loaded_at) loads, min(s.etl_loaded_at), max(s.etl_loaded_at), sum(closing_value) v
FROM fact_stock_week s JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=s.week_ending_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=3 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_week, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT (s2.store_id, p.sku)) nat_keys, sum(closing_value) v, sum(closing_units) u,
 sum(CASE WHEN s2.store_id>=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonstore, sum(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) test
FROM fact_stock_week s JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=s.week_ending_date
JOIN dim_store s2 ON s2.store_key=s.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=s.product_key
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=3 AND p.category ILIKE 'Paint%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT category, count(*), count(DISTINCT sku), min(valid_from), max(valid_to) FROM dim_product GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_week, s2.store_id, s2.store_name, count(*) n, sum(closing_value) v
FROM fact_stock_week s JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=s.week_ending_date
JOIN dim_store s2 ON s2.store_key=s.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=s.product_key
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=3 AND p.category = 'Paint & Decorating' AND d.fiscal_week IN (9,10) GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 2,1

WITH w AS (
 SELECT d.fiscal_week, s2.store_id, p.sku, p.product_name, p.delisted_on, p.is_current, s.closing_units, s.closing_value, s.receipts_units, s.adjustment_units, p.standard_unit_cost
 FROM fact_stock_week s JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=s.week_ending_date
 JOIN dim_store s2 ON s2.store_key=s.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=s.product_key
 WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=3 AND p.category='Paint & Decorating')
SELECT a.store_id, a.sku, a.product_name, a.delisted_on, a.closing_units, a.closing_value, a.standard_unit_cost
FROM w a WHERE a.fiscal_week=9 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM w b WHERE b.fiscal_week=10 AND b.store_id=a.store_id AND b.sku=a.sku) ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_week, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN closing_units<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg, sum(CASE WHEN closing_value <> round(closing_units*p.standard_unit_cost,2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) value_mismatch,
 sum(CASE WHEN p.delisted_on < s.week_ending_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) delisted_before, sum(CASE WHEN s.week_ending_date NOT BETWEEN p.valid_from AND p.valid_to THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) p_outside, sum(CASE WHEN s.week_ending_date NOT BETWEEN s2.valid_from AND s2.valid_to THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) s_outside
FROM fact_stock_week s JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=s.week_ending_date
JOIN dim_store s2 ON s2.store_key=s.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=s.product_key
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=3 AND p.category='Paint & Decorating' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH weekly AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_week, SUM(s.closing_value) AS closing_value, count(DISTINCT st.store_id) stores
  FROM fact_stock_week s
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = s.week_ending_date
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = s.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = s.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3
    AND st.store_id < 900 AND st.store_id <> 999
    AND cp.category = 'Paint & Decorating' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_period, ROUND(AVG(closing_value),2) AS avg_stock_value_at_cost_eur, count(*) weeks, min(stores) minstores, max(stores) maxstores FROM weekly
